mr_used: symmetry / equivariance block: a periodic boundary condition u(x)=u(P(x)) states that the solution is invariant under the period-L translation along a periodic axis (a discrete translation symmetry; Noether). P = periodic_point is the group-action map taking a boundary point to its periodic partner. PINN oracle for this block: P must be COMPUTABLE and a correct period map -- (a) left-edge x0=0 maps to right-edge x0=1; (b) involution P(P(x))=x (shift +L then partner shifts -L); (c) time coordinate preserved (time NOT periodic); (d) non-periodic spatial coords preserved. If P cannot be evaluated, the symmetry/periodicity MR is unenforceable.
fired_type: CRASH (TypeError: periodic_point() missing 1 required positional argument: 'component') -- GeometryXTime.periodic_point strips the time coord and calls space_geometry.periodic_point(x[:-1]) with ONE positional arg, but Hypercube/Rectangle.periodic_point(self, x, component) REQUIRES the periodic-axis component, so the symmetry-image map cannot be formed for any space-time boundary point.
verified: SELF-RUN pip: pre 0.8.6 FIRED (GeometryXTime.periodic_point([0.0,0.4,0.5], component=0) -> TypeError missing arg 'component') / post 0.9.0 HELD (P([0.0,0.4,0.5]) = [1.0,0.4,0.5]: left-edge x0=0 -> right-edge x0=1; involution P(P(x))=[0.0,0.4,0.5]=x; time t=0.5 preserved; non-periodic x1=0.4 preserved; all 4 symmetry checks pass).
upstream: DeepXDE git commit 8353540 (root cause: GeometryXTime.periodic_point called self.geometry.periodic_point(x[:-1]) -- 1 arg -- but the multi-D geometry's Hypercube.periodic_point(self, x, component) requires the periodic axis 'component'; fix passes component through: self.geometry.periodic_point(x[:-1], component). The same commit also removes a wrong no-op Disk.periodic_point: return x override that silently ignored periodicity; the crash path reproduced here is the GeometryXTime missing-component bug).
